description: This file contains utility functions and classes for organization creation, including validation of subdomains, email verification, domain setup, and related error handling within a larger application.

classes.name: OrgCreationError
classes.description: Custom error class for organization creation related errors.

methods.name: isNotACompanyEmail
methods.description: Checks if an email is not from a list of common company domains.

methods.name: assertSlugIsAvailable
methods.description: Validates if a subdomain slug is available, considering conflicts with existing organizations or teams.

methods.name: assertCanCreateOrg
methods.description: Performs various checks to determine if an organization can be created with the given parameters.

methods.name: findUserToBeOrgOwner
methods.description: Finds and enriches a user to be the owner of an organization based on email.

methods.name: setupDomain
methods.description: Configures the domain for the organization and notifies admins if needed.
